title: Evaluation of an input wire
statement: Let $F$ be a field with decidable equality, let $\iota$ be an input-index type, let $d\in\mathbb N$, let $R$ be a degree-$d$ resharer, and let $A$ be a finite set of parties. For every party-indexed input assignment $\mathrm{inp}$ and input label $i$, the BGW evaluation of the circuit consisting of the input wire $i$ is exactly the supplied assignment $\mathrm{inp}(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: A is a finite set of parties
inp is a party-indexed input assignment
replaced:
Let $F$ be a field, let $\iota$ be a type, let $R$ be a resharer, and let $A$ be a
finite set of parties. For any input assignment and input wire $i$, the evaluation of
that input circuit is the function assigning each party its input value at $i$.
